parcels_statewide.notes: Layer 'Nebraska Tax Parcels' inside hosted service Layers_Data_WFL1 (ArcGIS Online org 'University of Nebraska', owner jlee142_universityofne, item e587065fe19b40818f9b3512036c4b85, item modified 2024-10-24, layer lastEditDate 2024-07-22). STALE: CAMAUpdate values per county are Jan-Apr 2023 (ShapeUpdate 2023-02-17); it is a 2023 snapshot of the NebraskaMAP StatewideParcelsExternal dataset. Official host gis.ne.gov / giscat.ne.gov / www.nebraskamap.gov did not resolve today (official service would be https://gis.ne.gov/Enterprise/rest/services/StatewideParcelsExternal/FeatureServer, referenced by AGOL item b8c2f381f0c34463abb4094b10fa29ef). All 93 counties present; filter by County_ID = 3-digit county FIPS as TEXT (e.g. '079' Hall, '019' Buffalo, '053' Dodge, '119' Madison, '157' Scotts Bluff, '111' Lincoln, '141' Platte, '001' Adams, '025' Cass, '047' Dawson, '067' Gage, '155' Saunders, '177' Washington). Owner populated on 1,127,706 of 1,133,295 (first rows by OBJECTID are empty road/ROW polygons). State_PID = FIPS+Parcel_ID. Alternate fields: OW1_Address (full mailing string), Second_Owner_Name, Situs_Address, GIS_Acres, Land_Value, Improvements_Value, Sales_Date (epoch ms), Sales_Value. maxRecordCount 2000, capabilities Query. Sample (Hall): Parcel_ID 400000024, Current_Owner_Name 'STERKEL/SHIRLEY M, REVOCABLE TRUST', OW1_Address 'PO BOX 94, WOLBACH, NE 68882', Total_Assessed_Value 86722.

Terms read in licenseInfo: 'The use of the data files provided herewith are provided as a service to the requester and are not the official government records of the City of Grand Island or Hall County, Nebraska. Secondary dissemination of the data files is not licensed, approved, or authorized by the City of Grand Island or Hall County. ... The data is provided "AS IS." ... The recipient shall be solely liable for recipient's use or dissemination of any copyrighted, intellectual property, proprietary information, or trade secrets.' Covers all of Hall County (Grand Island, Doniphan, Wood River, Cairo, Alda). NO mailing address, value or acres fields - only PARCEL, CURRENT_OWNER, LEGAL, SITUS (often empty string), LATITUDE, LONGITUDE, AREASQFT (square feet). Owner populated on 28,016 of 28,615. Owner format 'SURNAME/FIRST'. maxRecordCount 2000, capabilities Query. Mailing addresses for Hall exist only in the stale statewide copy (County_ID='079').

parcels_counties.notes: Run by the county itself (ArcGIS Online owner ScottsBluffCo, item 18950c3990a14d95889d0ea00aa8984f 'Sex Offender Registry Parcel Map_WFL1', layer 2 'Parcels', copyrightText 'Scotts Bluff County Mapping Department', lastEditDate 2026-05-04 - about 6 months old, a copy published for a web map rather than a live assessor feed). Layer description read: 'The parcel layer was created and maintained for the Scotts Bluff County Assessor's Office to be used for taxation purposes. The parcels were created using recorded deeds within Scotts Bluff County, NE. The parcel layer is continuously updated with newly recorded deeds received from the Scotts Bluff County Register of Deeds Office.' Countywide (Scottsbluff, Gering, Terrytown, Mitchell, Morrill etc.). Shapefile-truncated field names: ownername2, owneraddre (line 1, often blank), owneradd_1 (street line), BuildingVa, Improvemen, LandValue (no single total value field - sum the three), Acreage (GIS acres), CADASTRAL, SaleDate, SaleAmount, LegalDescr. Owner populated on 21,427 of 21,491; owner format 'SURNAME/FIRST'. maxRecordCount 2000. Fresher partial layers from the same owner with full field names (parcelid, ownername1, owneraddress1, owneraddress2, mailcity, mailstate, mailzip, SitusAddress, BuildingValue, ImprovementValue, LandValue, LegalAcres): .../City_of_Scottsbluff_Parcels/FeatureServer/0 (8,261 parcels, Scottsbluff + Terrytown and ETJs, lastEdit 2026-11-05, item 3389bee8f9b54f22bdbce759ff27d8a5, licenseInfo empty) and .../City_of_Gering_Parcels/FeatureServer/0 (item 13e3198a866e4b069d835d933b67be1e, not sampled). County's public viewer is Schneider Beacon (not used).

parcels_counties.notes: Run by the City of Blair GIS (ArcGIS Online owner cpoulsenblair, item 28bea8773cbc4d04804e77f7c90e5886 'Parcel and Address (public)', snippet 'Blair Nebraska Parcel and Address.', layer 3 'Ownership Parcels', lastEditDate 2026-11-16 - current). Not the county assessor's own service, but the extent covers the whole of Washington County (lon -96.46..-95.91, lat 41.38..41.69), not just Blair; county's gWorks layer has 14,113 parcels with no owner fields. Owner populated on 14,829 of 15,727. Mail1 = street line; Mail2/Mail3 were empty in the samples, so city/state are probably in Mail2/Mail3 where present - check before use; Zipcode is ZIP+4 text. Situs holds 'VACANT'/'EXEMPT' for some parcels. PID is the same number as integer. CalcArea appears to be acres (31.29 for a quarter-quarter-size tract) - verify. Other fields: Legal, BookPage, PropClass, PropType. maxRecordCount 2000, capabilities Query.

summary: Projects: none verified - NDOT's Program Book service sits on gis.ne.gov, which did not resolve from the research machine. Parcels: statewide layer on giscat.ne.gov could not be checked for the same reason; owner layers verified for Douglas, Sarpy (2023 copy) and Lancaster (NRD compilation). Added 2026-11-21: a 2023 copy of the state's parcel compilation (1,133,295 rows, owners and mailing addresses, held: third-party copy, terms not found, stale); county owner layers recorded for Cass, Hall, Scotts Bluff, Washington and Thayer, all held. The 70 gWorks assessor services answer without owner names.
